modes.name: low_rank.svd
modes.contract: Supported layer transforms preserve the full-rank operator; applicability is checked for each layer.

modes.name: low_rank.onetime
modes.contract: Threshold selection preserves the requested operator-energy fraction with explicit zero/rank-one behavior.

modes.name: low_rank.dynamic
modes.contract: Dynamic-rank history, trainer wiring and stopping rules are not certified; use onetime rank selection.

modes.name: pruning.magnitude
modes.contract: The pruning plan validates inputs and preserves an independent baseline.

modes.name: pruning.activation_entropy
modes.contract: Activation accumulation and application of the returned pruned model require a separately validated implementation.

modes.name: quantization.ptq
modes.contract: Supported models are calibrated and converted without changing the independent float baseline.

modes.name: quantization.qat
modes.contract: Preparation is followed by student training before conversion; unsupported combinations fail explicitly.

modes.name: flatllm.rank_selector
modes.contract: Random prototype scores are not measured angular, gradient or activation importance.

modes.name: manifold_losses
modes.contract: The separate research branch is not an importable supported main implementation.

modes.name: flatllm.attention_cache
modes.contract: Transformer cache patching requires architecture-specific cache and multi-step generation tests; local MLP kernels do not certify this path.
